content.text: Still going through the screens: it's a long table, about 143 tracks across 12 companies. I'm scrolling the rest to see if there's anything at the bottom.

I'm going with **Harel, the "מניות" (stocks) track, number 8522**. I'm fairly sure. What decided it: Harel was the first company on the list and it's a name I know from ads. That track shows **24.04%** for 3 years and 14.64% for 5. Harel's own S&P 500 track, the thing my friends talk about, shows only 13.7% and costs a bit more (0.56% vs 0.55%). So same company, cheaper fee, nearly double the return. The fees all looked about the same anyway, 0.5% to 0.73%. The page never says what to do next, so my first step is probably finding Harel's site and opening it there.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page:** the big heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". The "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" button was already selected, and there was a row of filter buttons including "עוקב מדד S&P 500". I didn't tap anything, and I skipped the "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link.
- **The table:** I scrolled the whole thing with my thumb. I stopped on the company header bars (Harel, מור, אנליסט, מיטב, ילין לפידות, מגדל, מנורה מבטחים, אינפיניטי) and on the S&P and "מניות" rows. I only looked at the fee and the big return numbers.
- **What I noticed:**
  - Menora's S&P track is the cheapest, at 0.52%, but it has no 5-year number.
  - Some rows from companies I don't really know show 25–26%, but I didn't trust those.
  - Lots of rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" or show orange "עוד לא דווח" marks. That put me off.
- **The bottom:** a small note under the table about returns. Small text, so I didn't read it.

**Where I hesitated or got lost:**
- **Which company is this?** After a few screens the company bar is gone, and I couldn't tell whose rows I was looking at.
- **Too many options.** 143 tracks that look alike, and nothing on the page says "start here". Around screen 6 I'd normally have closed it.
- **S&P or stocks?** I wavered between Harel's S&P track and its "מניות" track.

**Words I didn't get:** "ההפקדות" vs "ההיסכון" (two different fees?), "מט״ח", "ברוטו", "חשיפה", "עוד לא דווח", "חדש", "גמיש". I also don't know what the number with the little arrow is (8522), what the yellow and green rings mean, or why there are dotted lines under the numbers.

**What I'd change:**
- Show what the fee costs in shekels on my 30,000 a year. Percentages mean nothing to me.
- Keep the company name on every row.
- Put a short "where to start" at the top.
- Tell me how to actually open one.
- Make the table shorter, or put the S&P filter in my face.
